From the judges' drafts' reasoning

To both parties. The trip mechanics themselves are not in dispute, and on them the driver is right. DRV-09755 tapped 'arrived' at 09:14:14 (EV-TRIP-02755), and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02755, weight 1.0, COMPLETE, 10-second cadence, no gaps) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same second, with 40 qualifying fixes. He then held position continuously for 390 seconds — against the 180-second free waiting period this trip's own platform_policy carries — and terminated at 09:20:47 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, more than three minutes after the required dwell had elapsed. That satisfies all four limbs of POL-NS-01 (arrival event, GPS proximity, dwell, reason code and timing). POL-NS-05 does not bite: the first qualifying fix is at the marker's own timestamp, the driver was stationary at the pin (min distance 0 m) and never at speed on the arrival timestamp, so the marker is genuine and the waiting clock needs no recomputation. POL-NS-06 gives no refund — the shortfall is negative, 390 s against 180 s, recorded as -210 s. POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-04 do not apply: the driver was inside the radius, not at a wrong face of the venue, and the only chat message is the driver's own 'im here' with no locating message from the rider, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails (its limb (c) also fails on the rider's track, which shows no qualifying fix within 100 m). POL-NS-10's grace windows are long past (cancellation about 14 minutes after acceptance, on an unscheduled trip). The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02755) reconciles to the $4.50 fee in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. EV-ADVIS-02755-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and nothing here rests on it. Standing alone, this would be a verified rider no-show and POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of $4.50 = $3.60, the anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d = 2, below 4; 2/110 = 0.018, below 0.08). But the case does not stand alone. POL-NS-09(c) sends a case to human review where rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d together show 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. Both read 2 (EV-RPROF-02755 and EV-DPROF-02755, each at weight 1.0) for this same pair, RDR-09755 and DRV-09755 on TRP-02755, and the rider's filing describes this as the third such cancellation and charge. That trigger is aimed at repeat behaviour a single-trip view cannot fairly assess, and it fires. I reject the driver's contrary argument (made under POL-GEN-01) insofar as it says the profile counters can never support an escalation: POL-GEN-01 expressly lists disputes_with_counterparty_90d on both profiles as citable for this test; what it excludes is the lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags) and the rider's bare assertion of a 'pattern', neither of which I have used. Because POL-NS-09 escalation is terminal and, per POL-GEN-03, replaces the ruling, no money moves now: the $4.50 disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold — not collected and not refunded — and the driver's compensation is not paid pending review. This is not a finding for either side. The question for the reviewer is whether the repeated rider/driver history (2 recorded counterparty disputes in 90 days, with the rider alleging a third) warrants anything different from the verified single-trip outcome, and the case summary goes to that reviewer with both briefs, the admissibility report, the clauses relied on and this reasoning. No referral clause fires: POL-NS-05's false-arrival record is not engaged (the marker was genuine) and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not trip. Confidence is 0.90: the escalation rests on two independent weight-1.0 profile artifacts, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, above the 0.70 floor; and the amount is held in any event.

No automated ruling was made. A reviewer decides within 24 hours of entry, or within 2 hours when the case carries a safety flag.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

What the record does not settle — and what no single-trip arithmetic in this file decides — is whether a third cancellation-and-charge between this same rider and driver should be adjudicated as though it stood alone. What the record does not settle — and what no single-trip arithmetic in this file decides — is whether a third cancellation-and-charge between this same rider and driver should be adjudicated as though it stood alone. That question is the one POL-NS-09(c) sends to a human reviewer, and it is where the rider's case rests. KEPT
  • DRIVER: The trip record carries the platform's own driver 'arrived' event for this trip: at 09:14:14 the driver tapped 'I'm Here' on TRP-02755, which is limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show test satisfied on telemetry rather than on assertion. KEPT; Arrival is independently established by GPS, not by the button: the trace holds 40 qualifying fixes inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m, and the first of them is timestamped 09:14:14 — the very same second as the arrival event — so the driver was inside the pickup geofence at (and before the end of) the marker event, satisfying limb (b) of POL-NS-01 under the POL-NS-02 proximity test. The trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 (10 s cadence, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0). KEPT; The dwell is long and continuous: the longest qualifying in-geofence run runs from 09:14:14 to 09:20:44, a continuous 390 seconds across 40 fixes. That is 210 seconds more than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, with no longer no_show_threshold_sec set), and it clears the 300-second STANDARD figure in the fee schedule as well, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied with room to spare. KEPT; The termination matches the no-show reason code exactly: no boarding event appears anywhere in the record and the trip was terminated by the driver at 09:20:47 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — 3 minutes 33 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 09:17:14 — which is limb (d) of POL-NS-01 on its face. KEPT; The arrival marker is a button tap and so is exposed to the false-arrival test, and it survives it: the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the marker's own timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), his track minimum distance is 0.0 m, and the stationary fixes sit inside the 50 m radius rather than more than 300 m out or at 15 km/h or above. There is therefore no false marker, the waiting clock needs no recomputation, and the fee is not defeated under POL-NS-05. KEPT; There is no waiting-period shortfall to refund: measured against the minimum in force the shortfall figure is negative — shortfall_sec -210.0 on a 390-second qualifying run against the 180-second STANDARD minimum — so the refund route in POL-NS-06 never opens. Because a single continuous in-geofence interval already exceeds the minimum, the interval-accumulation route in limb (i) is not needed either. KEPT; The driver does not rest anything on the traffic advisory, and says so: EV-ADVIS-02755-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and because the dwell is already sufficient on a single in-geofence interval the driver neither needs nor asserts limb (i) of POL-NS-06. Nothing in the driver's case depends on that absent artifact. KEPT; The wrong-entrance clause cannot rescue the rider here, because its premise is absent: POL-NS-03 applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas on this trace 40 qualifying fixes lie INSIDE the 50 m radius from 09:14:14 onward. The driver was at the pickup point, not at a wrong face of it. KEPT; The rider-contact clause cannot exonerate the rider either, on either required limb: the chat log's single message is the DRIVER'S 'im here', sent 09:14:44 and read 09:15:14, with no locating or coordinating message from the rider at all, so limb (a) fails; and the rider's own track holds zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, sitting 847.65 m to 855.43 m from the pin across all 70 fixes, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes rather than undecidable. Both the chat artifact and the GPS trace are COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the chat log's 1 message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, so there is no POL-NS-08(c) defect. KEPT; No grace provision protects this cancellation: it was made at 09:20:47, some 14 minutes after accepted_at 09:06:49, far outside the 180-second grace_after_match_sec, and the trip was not a scheduled trip (scheduled_at is null) so no advance-scheduled window applies. The non-chargeability routes in POL-NS-10(a) and (b) are therefore unavailable on this record. KEPT; The ledger is internally sound and matches the fee in force: cancellation_fee and total_charged are both 4.50, exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip, with no waiting-time line charged and every ledger line reconciling, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect that would force the amount down. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. KEPT; With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the fee in force — 0.80 x 4.50 = 3.60 SGD — and the anti-farming check does not trip, because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the 4 required) and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.018 (below the 0.08 rate). Both limbs of the check must hold and neither does, so compensation is payable rather than withheld. KEPT; The rider's assertion of a repeated pattern is a party statement, not a finding: under POL-GEN-01 profile data may not establish a fact about this trip or carry an adverse finding, and the only profile counters in issue on the driver's side — no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d, for the POL-NS-07 test — show no farming pattern. The deciding facts here rest on complete, weight-1.0 artifacts: the in-geofence dwell and the recorded reason code. KEPT
